text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A team of Bahraini experts will soon visit Jordan to study oil and gas exploration work there, Jordan's energy minister said.

- Electricity minister and the companies involved in the construction of the $458 million al-Hidd power and desalination plant in Bahrain signed an agreement to enable the financing of the project to go ahead.
- An Indian industrial delegation is to visit Bahrain in November.
- An Indian parliamentary group is coming to Bahrain later this month to discuss potential investments in a livestock farm and meat processing operation.
- A fire at a hotel in Bahrain on Tuesday did not cause more than 10,000 dinars in damages and none of the guests were injured, a hotel official said.
- Jordan's prime minister said Bahrain and Jordan are discussing setting up a joint bank to ease trade exchange between them.
